mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing paroxetine concentrations; additive serotonergic and CNS stimulant effects may occur.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine side effects (serotonin syndrome symptoms, hypertension, tachycardia, insomnia); consider dose adjustment or alternative stimulant if excessive CNS stimulation occurs.
